device_entry.description: 一个用于实验控制软件的非物理组件，用来依据 Tango 资源定位符连接 Tango 设备服务器，并按类型注解自动创建子设备或信号。它支持真实连接与模拟连接，适合将基于 Tango Controls 的实验仪器统一接入异步控制流程。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical software component for laboratory control systems that connects to Tango device servers using a Tango resource locator and can automatically create child devices or signals from annotations. It supports both real and mock connections, helping integrate Tango Controls-based instruments into an asynchronous experiment workflow.

schema.description: 连接到模拟 Tango 设备，并为子项建立模拟连接结构。
schema.description_en: Connect to a mock Tango device and create the mock child connection structure.

schema.description: 连接到真实 Tango 设备服务器，并按需要自动填充子设备或信号。
schema.description_en: Connect to a real Tango device server and auto-populate child devices or signals as needed.
